name: dogfood-alert-orchestrator
description: Dogfood app (v1.17-3) — Node.js Prometheus AlertManager style alert orchestrator driven behind a provider-neutral surface. 10 alert rules (threshold / rate / anomaly) evaluated + 3-level routing tree (severity → team → channel) + time-based silence with regex matcher + escalation ladder (L1 30s → L2 5min → L3 30min). @kiwa-lab/observability AlertRouter backs the mock adapter (KIWA_MODE=mock, default); the real adapter posts fires to a live Prometheus AlertManager HTTP API (KIWA_MODE=real, ALERTMANAGER_URL set). The fidelity harness diffs alert lifecycle traces (fire → route → silence → escalate → resolve) across mock vs real, feeding @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.
